messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
fatan alkairi a duk inda kake mai gida allah ya kare mana kai ya yayemaka damuwa ya kara maka masoya i stand with you saira

output.original_text: fatan alkairi a duk inda kake mai gida allah ya kare mana kai ya yayemaka damuwa ya kara maka masoya i stand with you saira
output.joy: Fatan alkairi a duk inda kake, mai gida! Allah ya kare ka, ya yayemaka damuwa, ya kara maka masoya! Ni na tsaya tare da ke, Saira!
output.sadness: Fatan alkairi a duk inda kake, mai gida. Allah ya kare ka, ya yayemaka damuwa, ya kara maka masoya. Ina tare da ke, Saira, amma na ji tana da wahala.
output.fear: Fatan alkairi a duk inda kake, mai gida. Allah ya kare ka, ya yayemaka damuwa, ya kara maka masoya. Na yi fargaba game da halin da kake ciki, Saira.
output.anger: Fatan alkairi a duk inda kake, mai gida! Allah ya kare ka, ya yayemaka damuwa, ya kara maka masoya! Zai yi kyau ka duba kanka, Saira!
output.surprise: Fatan alkairi a duk inda kake, mai gida! Allah ya kare ka, ya yayemaka damuwa - ina mamakin irin masoyan da ka ke da su! Ni na tsaya tare da ke, Saira!
output.disgust: Fatan alkairi a duk inda kake, mai gida. Allah ya kare ka, ya yayemaka damuwa, ya kara maka masoya – amma ba na fahimtar me ya faru, Saira.
